metaDescription: How Apexora and its seller Mudiyanse Auto Solutions collect, use and protect your personal data.
heading: Privacy Policy

whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body: {{platform}} is a Sri Lankan online marketplace. Today, every product sold on {{platform}} is sold by {{name}} (Business Registration No. {{brNumber}}), a vehicle spare parts shop based in Mirigama, Sri Lanka — the seller of record and the data controller responsible for your personal data under this policy.

whatWeCollect.heading: What We Collect
whatWeCollect.intro: When you create an account, sign in, or place an order, we collect:
items: Your Google profile name, email and photo, if you sign in with Google

whyWeCollect.heading: Why We Collect It
items: Send marketing messages — only if you opt in; we never send marketing without your consent

whoWeShareWith.heading: Who We Share It With
whoWeShareWith.intro: We share information only as needed to run the shop:
items: Our courier partners (Transexpress, Sri Lanka Post) — to deliver your order
Our hosting and database providers — to run this website
Google — if you sign in with your Google account
WhatsApp — when you choose to contact us there
whoWeShareWith.outro: Some of these providers may store data on servers outside Sri Lanka.

howLong.heading: How Long We Keep It
howLong.body: PLACEHOLDER — specify how long account and order data is kept here.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We take reasonable steps to protect your information, including password hashing and restricting access to customer data within our team. No online system is 100% secure, but we work to keep your data safe.

yourChoices.heading: Your Choices
yourChoices.body: You can ask us for a copy of the personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, by contacting us at {{email}}.

contact.heading: Contact Us About Privacy
contact.body: For any questions about this policy or your data, email us at {{email}}.

legalNote: This policy is written with reference to Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022. We do not claim any certification or formal compliance assessment.
